home.networkTitle: One overloaded teacher can't be everything.
home.networkText: An ICT teacher in a small town may teach 300 students in three schools. That's not anyone's fault — it's a gap. We fill it with mentors, peers and opportunities, and teachers stay at the centre as coaches.

teachers.title: You're the coach. Not the only source.
teachers.lead: No single teacher can know every language, tool and scholarship — and nobody should expect that. After the workshop, mentors and the platform take part of the load. You see how your class is doing and guide them.
allyPoints: You see progress — never grades or rankings of students.
Mentors answer the technical questions, so you can focus on motivation.
Ready-made lesson plans continue the workshop topic in 45 minutes.
Your school earns points for the monthly town prize.

tutor.eyebrow: Free · open source · works in Polish
tutor.title: A tutor that asks, not tells.
tutor.lead: Download a Socratic study partner for maths, biology and podstawy przedsiębiorczości. It won't hand you answers. It asks the right questions until you get there yourself, at any hour, even when your teacher can't.
tutor.downloadNote: ZIP · works in Claude and other AI apps that support skills

heroBubbles.text: Deal: you say the first step, I'll tell you if you're on track 👀
Check it: plug 2 back in. What do you get?

tutor.demoTitle: Same question. A different way of answering.
tutor.demoLead: Sample conversations. Notice that the tutor never gives the answer away: the student finds it.

moves.smaller: Breaks it into a smaller step
moves.invite: Invites you in, doesn't decide for you

principles.title: Invites, doesn't instruct
principles.text: It talks like a curious study partner, not an authority. “Let's figure it out together”, never “this is easy”.

principles.title: Co-creates with you
principles.text: Explanations start from what you already know, in your own words and examples.

principles.title: One hint at a time
principles.text: A five-step hint ladder. It only climbs when you're really stuck after trying.

principles.title: In your teacher's corner
principles.text: It never replaces or criticises your teacher. It's one more person helping you, at 11 pm before the test.

tutor.caseLead: Ola, 17, works at a café for the summer: 120 hours × 25 zł on an umowa zlecenie. Her goal is a laptop for 2 400 zł. The tutor walks you through her decisions, and you can swap in your own town, job and goal.
caseSteps: How much will she earn, gross and net? What gets deducted, and what doesn't for students under 26?
Umowa zlecenie or umowa o pracę: what changes?
Build her budget: needs, wants, savings.
Pick an account: does the higher interest rate really win?
Spot the trap: an “instant 0% loan” ad.
Explain it to a friend: the teach-back.
tutor.caseCta: Say “Let's do the summer job case” to the tutor
tutor.parentsTitle: Built so parents can say yes.
tutor.parentsLead: We designed the tutor with students' parents in mind too. Here's what they usually ask.

parentsFaq.q: Isn't this just a cheating tool?
parentsFaq.a: It's built to do the opposite. It won't give answers or write graded work. It asks questions and makes the student explain the topic back.

parentsFaq.q: What does it know about my child?
parentsFaq.a: The skill itself is a text file and collects nothing. It tells the AI not to ask for surname, address, school or photos of documents.

parentsFaq.q: Can I see what they're learning?
parentsFaq.a: At the end, the tutor offers a short summary. The student decides whether to share it with a parent or teacher. It never contains grades.

parentsFaq.q: What if my child is stressed?
parentsFaq.a: The tutor pauses studying, encourages talking to a trusted adult and mentions the free helpline for young people: 116 111.

tutor.summaryTitle: Example summary the student can share
summaryLines: 📘 What we worked on: percentages and discounts
✅ What you can do now: calculate a discount after a discount, and explain why 20% + 20% isn't 40%
❓ Question for your teacher: how does this work with VAT?
tutor.ageNote: Age: many AI apps, including Claude's consumer apps, require users to be 18+. Younger students should use the tutor at school, through a tool the school approves, or together with a parent.
tutor.parentsLink: Read the one-page guide for parents (EN / PL)
